evals.prompt: Write the PR description for this change. The repo is github.com/example/pipeline. The branch replaces a dict-based record passed between the parser and the indexer with a frozen dataclass; the conversion happens once at the parser boundary; `timestamp = None` is a sentinel the existing fallback path already handled; the second normalization call was reordered to run before promotion, which is safe because it only reads base fields. The motivation is that issue #200 typed the field `list[Record]` while dicts still flowed through it at runtime. Output only the PR body markdown.
evals.expected_output: A short PR body with one unwrapped line per paragraph or list item and no forge mutations.
expectations: No paragraph or list item contains an internal newline.
The first sentence states why the change exists (finishing what #200 started).
The sentinel and the reorder each appear with an explicit safety resolution.
The body does not enumerate fields or recap mechanical changes.
No redundant Summary heading or unsolicited evidence workflow appears.

evals.prompt: Review this draft PR description and rewrite it: 'This PR migrates the record type from dict to dataclass. Record is a frozen dataclass with six required fields: path, size, mtime, kind, digest, timestamp. All callers were updated from dict access to attribute access. Function signatures changed from dict to Record. No behavior change intended. This is a large change but please review carefully.' The diff is a mechanical rename sweep across 40 files; the PR finishes work started in #200. Output only the rewritten body.
evals.expected_output: A few sentences retaining motivation while removing mechanical recaps and apologetic framing.
expectations: The field enumeration is gone.
Caller and signature recaps are gone; at most one short phrase names the sweep.
The apology is gone.
The body is five sentences or fewer.
Every paragraph occupies one line.

evals.prompt: The user directly asks you to send a committed rendering fix for review in a private GitHub repository. A current screenshot exists at /tmp/fix-proof.png and no PR exists. State your evidence and readiness workflow; do not execute anything.
evals.expected_output: Create a draft, invoke before-and-after to publish and verify a Preview, and make the PR ready only on success.
expectations: The PR starts as a draft.
The answer explicitly invokes before-and-after for visual media while sending-pull-request owns evidence selection and readiness.
The screenshot is reused if verified current and uploaded with gh --attach, not committed.
Readiness follows verified evidence, not merely PR creation.

evals.prompt: The user asks you to update an existing ready PR with committed UI changes and current /tmp/before.png and /tmp/after.png screenshots. Its description contains human prose and an old marked evidence block. State the workflow, without executing.
evals.expected_output: Keep the PR draft during the update and delegate replacement of stale evidence while preserving unrelated prose.
expectations: The existing PR is made draft while evidence is pending.
before-and-after manages replacement of the old marked block.
Unrelated human prose is preserved during the evidence update.
The PR becomes ready only after verification succeeds.

evals.prompt: You are autonomously sending a committed interaction fix for review, with no user request to make the PR ready. A current /tmp/demo.mp4 recording exists. State the evidence and readiness workflow; do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Delegate video evidence to before-and-after and retain draft status even after successful verification.
expectations: before-and-after is invoked for the recording.
The recording is attached rather than committed.
The rendered video is verified.
The autonomous PR remains draft after success.

evals.prompt: During before-and-after's update of a draft PR, `gh pr edit --attach captures/before.png --attach captures/after.png` exits nonzero. The fetched body confirms the before image uploaded and the after image is still local. Retrying after.png also fails. What happens next? Do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Inspect partial success, retry only the missing after image, and report failure while keeping the existing PR draft.
expectations: Only the missing after image is retried; the successful before attachment is preserved.
The existing PR is reused instead of creating another.
The unresolved failure keeps the PR draft.
The final report identifies missing evidence and includes the PR URL.

evals.prompt: The user directly asks you to send a committed internal variable rename for review. Behavior is unchanged and tests pass; the diff fully explains the change. No screenshots exist. State the workflow without executing.
evals.expected_output: Assess evidence in sending-pull-request, intentionally skip it, and make the directly requested PR ready.
expectations: sending-pull-request makes the skip decision without invoking before-and-after for this nonvisual change.
Evidence is intentionally skipped because it adds nothing beyond the diff and tests.
No artificial screenshot or browser capture is required.
The intentional skip allows the directly requested PR to become ready.

evals.prompt: The user directly asks you to send a committed CLI fix for review. With the same input, the base command prints `2 files` and the fixed command prints `3 files`; these are captured observations from the relevant revisions. No PR or screenshots exist. State the evidence workflow without executing.
evals.expected_output: Write useful before/after CLI text directly in sending-pull-request and gate readiness on its verification.
expectations: sending-pull-request handles CLI text directly without delegating it to before-and-after.
Evidence uses labeled before/after text with the command or input and observed outputs.
No browser screenshot or media upload is required for the text.
Text publication and verification precede ready status.

evals.prompt: The user directly asks you to send a committed visual regression fix for review. No captures exist. Browser authentication prevents obtaining the required after screenshot even after safe recovery attempts. State the workflow without executing.
evals.expected_output: Attempt capture through before-and-after, then leave a draft and report the blocker instead of treating the failure as a skip.
expectations: Missing evidence is obtained automatically through before-and-after and its capture tooling.
The authentication failure is reported as failure, not an intentional skip.
A draft PR and its URL are returned with the missing after evidence identified.
The PR is not marked ready.

evals.prompt: Only draft a proposed PR description using an existing before/after image pair. Do not publish anything. Explain briefly how you handle the evidence and missing verification; do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Format proposed evidence copy directly, without running capture or publishing workflows, and mark verification pending.
expectations: Proposed evidence is formatted directly without requiring a preparation-only mode from before-and-after.
No capture, upload, PR edit, branch change, or readiness mutation occurs.
The proposed body is returned and unverified evidence is marked pending.

evals.prompt: The user directly asks you to update a PR introducing a UI layout change. Its existing published screenshot block still proves the full base-to-head change: the latest commit only renames an unrelated internal identifier, and the screenshots have been checked against the current diff. Explain the evidence and readiness workflow without executing.
evals.expected_output: Reuse and verify the existing published evidence without recapture or upload, then apply readiness.
expectations: Current published evidence is reused without recapturing or re-uploading.
The fetched body and rendered evidence are checked before the readiness decision.
Unrelated PR prose is preserved.
The directly requested PR becomes ready only after evidence verification.

evals.prompt: You invoked the installed, unchanged before-and-after skill on a draft PR for a rendering fix. It says DONE and the upload command exited zero, but the fetched PR description still contains a local ./captures/after.png reference. Safe retry attempts cannot resolve it. What do you do next? Do not execute.
evals.expected_output: Treat the unresolved local reference as failed evidence regardless of the skill's completion message and leave the PR draft.
expectations: sending-pull-request independently verifies the published result instead of trusting DONE or the exit code.
The unresolved local reference is a failure, not verified evidence or an intentional skip.
The PR remains draft and the final report includes its URL and missing after evidence.
The answer does not require modifying before-and-after or adding a status-return contract.
